ray_plane_range — DRIVE lidar op

• Data kinds: points × points → signal

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ray_plane_range(origin, dirs, plane) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import lidarsim; lidarsim.ray_plane_range(origin, dirs, plane) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("ray_plane_range"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

原点 origin から方向 dirs (...,3) のレイが平面 ax+by+cz+d=0 に当たるまでの距離。

閉形式 t = −(n·O + d)/(n·D)、距離は t·‖D‖。前方(t > 0)に当たらない・平行なら inf。法線がゼロなら ValueError。
